note:
KeyCode Stage, stripped back: one beam in the middle with two pars either side of it, all on a single 3.6 m bar at 2.9 m. This is the shape the room runs on a quiet night, and it is the smallest rig here that can still do something with POSITION -- four pars split two inner and two outer, so a mirrored look has a real pair to work with, and the beam in the centre gives the bar a middle to answer.

Positions in metres in the AUDIENCE frame: at = [x, depth, height], +x = the audience's right. The par is the GDTF LED PAR 64 RGBW and the beam is the Robe Robin MMX Spot, the same two devices the bigger arena rig uses -- so a show made here plays there without a single edit, which is the whole point of the layout being a property of the venue rather than of the show.
